sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: There's a big old apartment building in South Minneapolis that looks out of place.
sentences.zh: 在南明尼阿波利斯有一栋古老的大型公寓楼，看起来与周围环境格格不入。

sentences.en: It's in a residential neighborhood with small bungalows and some auto body shops.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一个由小型平房和一些汽车修理厂组成的住宅区里。

sentences.en: But this apartment building fills up an entire corner lot.
sentences.zh: 但这座公寓楼却占满了一整块转角地皮。

sentences.en: I've biked past this place hundreds of times, and it always struck me as kind of weird.
sentences.zh: 我骑自行车从这个地方经过过上百次，它总是给我一种有点怪异的感觉。

sentences.en: I started digging through old newspapers, and I found out why it's there.
sentences.zh: 我开始翻阅旧报纸，然后我找到了它存在的原因。

sentences.en: That building is the last remnant of an early 1900s amusement park.
sentences.zh: 那栋建筑是20世纪初游乐园的最后遗迹。

sentences.en: A friend of a friend named Hillary lives there now, and she gave me a tour.
sentences.zh: 一个朋友的朋友名叫希拉里，现在就住在那里，她带我参观了一下。

sentences.en: We are at my apartment building.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在我的公寓楼里。

sentences.en: It's on the corner of 31st and 31st in South Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 它位于南明尼阿波利斯31街和31街的交界处。

sentences.en: As I understand it, there was an amusement park here.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，这里曾经有一个游乐园。

sentences.en: The park had a roller coaster and a dance hall and a log flume,
sentences.zh: 公园里有过山车、舞厅和激流勇进，

sentences.en: but the biggest attraction was something much stranger.
sentences.zh: 但最大的吸引力却是一个更加奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: A bizarre sideshow that used to fill the apartment complex where Hillary lives now.
sentences.zh: 一个奇异的杂耍表演，曾经充斥着希拉里现在居住的公寓大楼。

sentences.en: When she signed the lease, her landlord told her the building used to be called the Infantorium.
sentences.zh: 当她签租约时，房东告诉她这栋楼以前叫育婴堂。

sentences.en: What he said at the time was like they had premature babies,
sentences.zh: 他当时说的话就像是他们有早产儿，

sentences.en: like living in this building and being taken care of in the building
sentences.zh: 就像住在楼里并在楼里得到照顾一样

sentences.en: as part of the attraction of the park.
sentences.zh: 作为公园游乐项目的一部分。

sentences.en: Visitors to the Infantorium would pay 10 cents to enter a spacious room full of glass boxes.
sentences.zh: 育婴堂的游客要付10美分才能进入一个摆满玻璃箱的宽敞房间。

sentences.en: They were incubators, with tiny premature babies on display.
sentences.zh: 它们是孵化器，里面展示着微小的早产儿。

sentences.en: And this wasn't the only place this was happening.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是唯一发生这种事情的地方。

sentences.en: The fact that there was a pavilion for incubator babies at Wonderland
sentences.zh: 仙境乐园里有一个孵化婴儿展馆的事实

sentences.en: Lauren Mabinovitz is an amusement park historian.
sentences.zh: 劳伦·马比诺维茨是一位游乐园历史学家。

sentences.en: Incubators for premature babies were, oddly enough,
sentences.zh: 说来也怪，早产儿保温箱

sentences.en: a phenomenon at the turn of the century
sentences.zh: 是世纪之交的一种现象

sentences.en: that was available at state and county fairs and amusement parks
sentences.zh: 它更多出现在各州和各县的集市以及游乐园里

sentences.en: At this moment in history, if you wanted your at-risk premature baby to survive,
sentences.zh: 在历史上的这个时刻，如果你想让高危早产儿存活下来，

sentences.en: you pretty much had to bring them to an amusement park.
sentences.zh: 你几乎只能把他们带到游乐园去。

sentences.en: These incubator shows cropped up across America.
sentences.zh: 这些保温箱展览在美国各地如雨后春笋般涌现。

sentences.en: They were the main source of health care for premature babies for over 40 years.
sentences.zh: 在40多年的时间里，它们是早产儿医疗保健的主要来源。

sentences.en: When the incubator attractions started in the late 1800s,
sentences.zh: 当19世纪末保温箱游乐项目开始时，

sentences.en: the world was a lot deadlier.
Almost one in five babies in the United States died before childhood,
sentences.zh: 在美国，几乎每五个婴儿中就有一个在童年之前夭折，

sentences.en: and that was an improvement from the previous decades.
sentences.zh: 而这已经是比前几十年有所改善了。

sentences.en: At the turn of the century, 19 of 20 births were still happening at home,
sentences.zh: 世纪之交时，仍有20分之19的出生是在家中进行的，

sentences.en: which isn't a problem if your baby is healthy, but not all of them were.
sentences.zh: 如果你的孩子很健康，这不是问题，但并非所有孩子都如此。

sentences.en: Like today, a lot of babies were born too early.
sentences.zh: 就像今天一样，有很多婴儿出生得太早。

sentences.en: The majority of American hospitals had nothing to help them.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数美国医院都无能为力。
没有技术，没有特殊的技能。

sentences.en: There was no central heating to keep them warm.
sentences.zh: 没有中央供暖来为他们保暖。

sentences.en: Doctors would place heated bricks in cribs and cross their fingers.
sentences.zh: 医生会把加热的砖块放进婴儿床里，然后祈求好运。

sentences.en: In private, people tried everything to keep premature babies alive.
sentences.zh: 私下里，人们尝试了一切方法来让早产儿活下来。

sentences.en: They put these infants in boxes stuffed with feathers to keep them warm.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些婴儿放在塞满羽毛的盒子为了保暖。

sentences.en: They rubbed oil on the babies and kept them near fireplaces.
sentences.zh: 他们在婴儿身上擦油，并把他们放在壁炉附近。

sentences.en: But more than three-quarters of premature babies were dying.
sentences.zh: 但超过四分之三的早产儿都夭折了。

sentences.en: And in America, no one in the medical community was trying to solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 在美国，医疗界没有人试图解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But things look different over in France.
sentences.zh: 但在法国那边情况看起来则不同。

sentences.en: French doctors stole an idea from the poultry industry,
sentences.zh: 法国医生从家禽业偷学了一个想法，

sentences.en: which used incubators to hatch chicken eggs.
sentences.zh: 家禽业使用孵化器来孵化鸡蛋。
他们设计了一个人类版本。

sentences.en: Basically, it was a warm box, heated by a hot water tank below.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它是一个温暖的盒子，由底部的热水箱加热。

sentences.en: In the 1890s, a Frenchman named Alexander Lyon modernized the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪90年代，一个名叫亚历山大·里昂的法国人将这一切进行了现代化改造。

sentences.en: The air in Lyon's incubator was heated by a pipe flowing with hot water.
sentences.zh: 里昂的保温箱里的空气是通过流着热水的管道加热的。

sentences.en: The temperature was pretty consistent, and the box was ventilated.
sentences.zh: 温度相当稳定，并且盒子是通风的。

sentences.en: But Lyon's real innovation was to put a big glass window on the box.
sentences.zh: 但里昂真正的创新是在盒子上装了一扇大玻璃窗。

sentences.en: And then he filled the box with a baby.
sentences.zh: 然后他在盒子里放了一个婴儿。
他建造了一台更好的机器，

sentences.en: and he displayed it at the Berlin Industrial Exposition in 1896.
sentences.zh: 并于1896年在柏林工业博览会上展出了它。

sentences.en: Don Raffel is the author of a new book about the unexpected origins of modern incubation.
sentences.zh: 唐·拉费尔是一本关于现代孵化起源的新书的作者。

sentences.en: He showed the new machine with preemies inside, and it was a sensation.
sentences.zh: 他展示了装有早产儿的新机器，这引起了轰动。

sentences.en: There were drinking hall songs about it.
sentences.zh: 当时甚至有关于它的酒馆歌曲。

sentences.en: He called it Die Kinderbrutenstalt, which was literally child hatchery.
sentences.zh: 他称之为Die Kinderbrutenstalt，字面意思就是儿童孵化场。

sentences.en: And so it took on the environment of a sideshow.
sentences.zh: 于是它便呈现出了杂耍表演的环境。

sentences.en: Some carnival showmen bought knockoff machines
sentences.zh: 一些嘉年华演出商购买了山寨机器

sentences.en: and started charging entry to their own premature baby shows.
sentences.zh: 并开始对他们自己的早产儿展览收取门票。

sentences.en: But keeping a baby alive is more complicated than putting them in a box and flipping a switch.
sentences.zh: 但是让婴儿活下来比把他们放进盒子里并按一下开关要复杂得多。

sentences.en: So most of them got out of the business pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以他们大多数人很快就退出这个行业了。

sentences.en: But one showman was hooked on this idea.
sentences.zh: 但有一个演出商迷上了这个想法。

sentences.en: In 1897, Dr. Martin Cooney put on his first incubator baby show in London.
sentences.zh: 1897年，马丁·库尼医生在伦敦举办了他的第一个保温箱婴儿展。

sentences.en: Somehow he may have just gotten onto the idea of this is kind of a cool way to make money in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，他最初可能只是觉得这是一种赚钱的酷炫方式。

sentences.en: So he went with this show.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定做这个演出。

sentences.en: Unlike other showmen, Cooney hired nurses to hold the babies and feed them breast milk.
sentences.zh: 与其他演出商不同，库尼雇用了护士来抱婴儿并喂他们母乳。

sentences.en: The babies were healthier and survived at higher rates.
sentences.zh: 婴儿更健康，存活率也更高。

sentences.en: So Dr. Cooney decided to try it out in the United States at the Omaha World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 于是库尼医生决定在美国的奥马哈世界博览会上尝试一下。

sentences.en: Details were always a little vague when Cooney told his life story to Americans.
sentences.zh: 当库尼向美国人讲述他的人生经历时，细节总是有点含糊。

sentences.en: But a few points stayed consistent.
sentences.zh: 但有几点始终保持一致。

sentences.en: He was from Europe, and he was trained in Germany and France,
sentences.zh: 他来自欧洲，曾在德国和法国接受培训，

sentences.en: which were decades ahead of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在医学教育方面，这两个国家比美国领先了几十年。

sentences.en: He called himself Dr. Martin Cooney, though his given name was actually Michael Cohn.
sentences.zh: 他自称马丁·库尼医生，尽管他的本名其实叫迈克尔·科恩。

sentences.en: And he said he'd just arrived in the U.S.
though he'd actually emigrated from Poland about a decade earlier.
sentences.zh: 尽管他实际上在大约十年前就已经从波兰移民了。

sentences.en: Like a good showman, he had a knack for exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 就像一个优秀的演出商一样，他很有夸大的天赋。

sentences.en: Sometimes he said he invented the incubators.
sentences.zh: 有时他说他发明了保温箱。

sentences.en: Dr. Cooney beckoned people to his show with bold, hand-painted signs
sentences.zh: 库尼医生用醒目的手绘招牌吸引人们来看他的展览，

sentences.en: that said things like wonderful invention and infant incubators with living infants.
sentences.zh: 上面写着诸如奇妙发明和带有活体婴儿的婴儿保温箱之类的话。

sentences.en: Lots of spectators came, and so did parents of premature babies,
sentences.zh: 大批观众前来，早产儿的父母也是如此，

sentences.en: who handed them over to Dr. Cooney, hoping for a miracle.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子交到库尼医生手里，希望能出现奇迹。

sentences.en: Cooney perfected his sideshow at the 1901 World's Fair in Buffalo, New York.
sentences.zh: 库尼在1901年纽约州布法罗世界博览会上完善了他的杂耍表演。

sentences.en: That fair has gone down in infamy as the place where President William McKinley was shot
sentences.zh: 那场博览会因威廉·麦金莱总统被枪击
并随后死于坏疽而闻名于世。

sentences.en: But aside from that, people had a really good time at the fair.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，人们在博览会上玩得很开心。

sentences.en: Dr. Cooney was set up on the Midway.
sentences.zh: 库尼医生驻扎在中途游乐区。

sentences.en: It's the section filled with carnival rides and sideshows.
sentences.zh: 那是布满嘉年华游乐设施和杂耍表演的区域。

sentences.en: And in Buffalo, it was popping off,
sentences.zh: 在布法罗，那里简直火爆极了，

sentences.en: with attractions like House Upside Down
and Jerusalem on the Morning of the Crucifixion.
sentences.zh: 和受难日早晨的耶路撒冷之类的景点。

sentences.en: Thousands of people paid 10 cents each
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人每人支付10美分

sentences.en: to see Dr. Cooney's incubator show.
sentences.zh: 来观看库尼医生的保温箱展览。
外面有招揽生意的叫卖者在喊着，

sentences.en: don't forget to see the babies.
Maybe the future president is inside.
sentences.zh: 也许未来的总统就在里面。

sentences.en: He knew how to be a showman.
sentences.zh: 他懂得如何成为一个演出商。

sentences.en: He knew how to talk to people,
and he loved talking to people.
Dr. Cooney greeted thousands of people on the Midway.
sentences.zh: 库尼医生在中途游乐区接待了成千上万的人。

sentences.en: His exhibit was full of futuristic glass incubators.
sentences.zh: 他的展览里到处都是充满未来感的玻璃保温箱。

sentences.en: One reporter wrote in Cosmopolitan that
sentences.zh: 一位记者在《时尚cosmopolitan》杂志上写道，

sentences.en: Cooney's incubator babies were more exciting than Niagara Falls.
sentences.zh: 库尼的保温箱婴儿比尼亚加拉大瀑布还要激动人心。

sentences.en: Newspapers as far away as Hawaii
reported on the survival of the infants.
sentences.zh: 都报道了这些婴儿的存活情况。

sentences.en: It was like a reality TV show in some ways,
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，它就像一个真人秀节目，

sentences.en: where there were people who would come every week
and they'd have a favorite that they'd be rooting for.
sentences.zh: 他们会有自己支持并希望其获胜的最爱。

sentences.en: A local medical journal reported that
sentences.zh: 当地的一份医学期刊报道说，

sentences.en: 48 of the 52 babies delivered to Cooney that summer
sentences.zh: 那年夏天送到库尼那里的52个婴儿中有48个

sentences.en: But even so, American doctors were not
sentences.zh: 即便如此，美国医生也没有

sentences.en: banging down Cooney's door for his machines.
sentences.zh: 踏破库尼的门槛来买他的机器。

sentences.en: This life-saving technology was stuck on the Midway.
sentences.zh: 这项救命的技术被困在了中途游乐区。

sentences.en: Despite the big crowds and the good press,
sentences.zh: 尽管人山人海，舆论反响也很好，

sentences.en: Cooney was still spending more money than he was bringing in.
sentences.zh: 但库尼的花销仍然超过了他的收入。

sentences.en: To build an exhibit for a World's Fair
sentences.zh: 为世界博览会搭建一个展馆

sentences.en: was a tremendous amount of work.
sentences.zh: 是一项极其繁重的工作。

sentences.en: Safety, points of entrance and egress,
You basically had to build a NICU.
sentences.zh: 你基本上必须建造一个新生儿重症监护室。

sentences.en: And then when the whole thing is over,
you have to tear it all down.

sentences.zh: 幸运的是对于库尼来说，

sentences.en: a new fad was sweeping the country in the early 1900s.
sentences.zh: 20世纪初一股新风潮正席卷全国。

sentences.en: Amusement parks took all the excitement of the fair midways
sentences.zh: 游乐园吸收了集市中途游乐区的所有刺激元素
并将它们变成了永久设施。

sentences.en: amusement parks were popping up all over the country.
sentences.zh: 游乐园在全国各地如雨后春笋般涌现。

sentences.en: apologized on behalf of the city.
sentences.zh: 代表这座城市进行了道歉。

sentences.en: We regret that we are possibly the only city in the country of any consequence
sentences.zh: 我们感到遗憾的是，我们可能是全国唯一一个有点影响力的城市

sentences.en: that will go through the coming summer season
sentences.zh: 将在即将到来的夏季中度过
人口至少达到两万的城市

sentences.en: and amusement parks were all about unbridled pleasure.
sentences.zh: 而游乐园的核心就是无拘无束的快乐。

sentences.en: It's not an intellectual thing at all.
sentences.zh: 这完全不是什么高雅的事情。

sentences.en: It's just a kind of giddy, physical amusement.
sentences.zh: 它只是一种令人晕眩的、身体上的愉悦。

sentences.en: The attendance figures for these parks are phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 这些游乐园的入场人数惊人。

sentences.en: You could get things like a quarter of the population
of a medium-sized city on a weekend.
sentences.zh: 你可能会吸引一个中等城市四分之一的人口。

sentences.en: Most of the early parks were owned by electric trolley companies
sentences.zh: 早期的大多数游乐园都属于电车公司，

sentences.en: who used the parks to get passengers on their trains.
sentences.zh: 他们利用游乐园来吸引乘客乘坐他们的列车。

sentences.en: The trolley lines would also end at the amusement park,
sentences.zh: 电车线路的终点也会设在游乐园，

sentences.en: and the electric cables from the train
would be hooked up to power the roller coasters.
sentences.zh: 会被连接起来为过山车供电。

sentences.en: The parks were places where new technology
At the time, there was a lot of uneasiness about new technology.
sentences.zh: 当时，人们对新技术存在很多不安。

sentences.en: Electric trains, lights, and motors weren't always safe.
sentences.zh: 电车、电灯和马达并不总是安全的。

sentences.en: technology wasn't something to be feared or mistrusted.
sentences.zh: 技术不再是令人害怕或不信任的东西。

sentences.en: making them part of leisure and recreation,
sentences.zh: 让它们成为休闲和娱乐的一部分，

sentences.en: acclimated people to them physically with their bodies,
sentences.zh: 人们在身体上适应了它们，

sentences.en: made them pleasurable at a time
when there might be some anxiety
When people got on thrill rides

sentences.zh: 当人们坐上惊险游乐设施

sentences.en: they saw that technology could be fun and safe.
In a way, Dr. Cooney's incubator babies
sentences.zh: 他们发现技术既有趣又安全。

sentences.en: were the essence of amusement parks.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，库尼医生的暖箱婴儿
正是游乐园的精髓所在。

sentences.en: caught the eye of two businessmen
sentences.zh: 而库尼在布法罗的展览

sentences.en: who were planning to build a brand-new park in Coney Island.
sentences.zh: 吸引了两位商人的目光，

sentences.en: They saw, this is a really cool show.
sentences.zh: 他们正计划在康尼岛建造一个全新的公园。

sentences.en: It's as interesting as a ride.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，这个展览真的很酷。

sentences.en: This would work at an amusement park.
sentences.zh: 它和游乐设施一样有趣。

sentences.en: Coney Island already had two other self-contained amusement parks.
sentences.zh: 这在游乐园里一定行得通。

sentences.en: And until it burned down in 1896,
sentences.zh: 康尼岛已经有了两个独立的游乐园，

sentences.en: a seven-story hotel shaped like an elephant.
sentences.zh: 还有一座在1896年烧毁的七层大象形状的酒店。

sentences.en: But these businessmen were taking it to the next level.
sentences.zh: 但这些商人正将它提升到一个新的水平。

sentences.en: Their new endeavor would be called Luna Park.
sentences.zh: 他们的新项目将被命名为月神公园。

sentences.en: It featured a ride imported from Buffalo
sentences.zh: 它主打一个从布法罗引进的游乐设施，

sentences.en: called A Trip to the Moon.
It brought passengers into a papier-mâché fantasy world
sentences.zh: 它把乘客带入一个纸浆构成的奇幻世界，
里面长满了科学上错误的植物，
还有两百名扮演月球人的演员。

sentences.en: And among Luna Park's flagship attractions
sentences.zh: 月神公园的招牌景点之一
就是库尼医生的暖箱婴儿。

sentences.en: When the sun set on May 16, 1903,
Luna Park switched on 250,000 electric light bulbs
